title: renders the input preview as the primary label with the ref id demoted to secondary text
verifies: the navigator leads with input_preview and demotes the ref id to secondary text

title: falls back to the ref id when no input preview was captured
verifies: a null-preview item shows only the ref id and no preview span

title: backfills the navigator with the preview returned by the detail endpoint for an older item
verifies: opening an older null-preview item adopts the detail endpoint's preview in place

title: renders the empty state when the queue has no items
verifies: a zero-item queue shows the empty state and no navigator items
